enforcement: Go server-owned policy, immutable per-Run contract and actual reserved request output limit. Amounts are nested restrictions on the same cumulative ledger, never additional independent balances.
historical_contracts: Retain original output and local constraints for settlement; never rewrite historical costs, hashes, attempts or UNKNOWN occupancy.
stop: Actual cache misses settle normally. Unknown fees retain the reservation and halt new paid calls; no automatic retries or unreviewed zero-cost assumptions.
scope: Internal counts, token caps and lanes can be revised under the user's autonomous M3 authorization with a new version and corresponding validation. Cumulative CNY 100 remains the hard user cap.
